multiple_testing: BH within each gene contrast; BH across all estimable module-by-contrast tests; no primary therapeutic claims

abundance.filter: nonnegative finite rows with nonzero abundance in at least one sample; report constant/unmapped rows

module_score: mean of within-dataset standardized gene log-expression, frozen gene sets; no pooling datasets
minimum_score_genes_role: score estimability only, not biological coverage acceptance
duplicate_symbol_score_policy: mean transformed expression across exact mapped input rows; record counts
duplicate_feature_policy: retain exactly identical sample vectors and gene symbols once; conflicting duplicated feature IDs stop analysis; never sum repeated annotation rows
mouse_human_mapping: reuse frozen NCBI reciprocal unique GeneID orthologs; no uppercase identity inference

GSE325931.reason: all iron/RSL3 samples in batches 5/6, all vehicle samples batches 1/3/4; treatment and batch nonidentifiable

GSE275834.reason: count-labelled columns have fractional values and quantification provenance is insufficient; no rounding or treating these as raw integer counts
GSE275834.structural_rows: exclude non-Ensembl annotation continuation rows only if all sample counts missing

condition_selection: all specified conditions retained; no best-condition ranking
